title: NormalizedEvidence
description: Stage 1 (Ingest) output: one evidence item after validation, in the exact shape the AI service receives in a job payload. Produced by the Go API from validated uploads; the AI service must treat it as read-only input. Field semantics mirror TECH_SPEC §5.4 with the R-05/R-07 refinements: identities are UUIDs, hashes are the source of truth for dedup and input snapshots.

type.description: Evidence type per PRD P0-2. For 'url' this object describes a snapshot (or a registration-only placeholder when snapshotting is not performed); live fetching never happens implicitly.

source_uri.description: Original source reference (original filename as metadata, or the registered URL). Never a long-lived public link.

object_key.description: Storage object key inside the private bucket. Required when type != text.

sha256.description: Hash of the stored bytes (or of the snapshot/text content). Used for dedup, job input manifests and audit-comparison keys.

captured_at.description: When the material was captured/uploaded (UTC, RFC 3339).

processing_status.description: Only READY evidence may be sent to the AI service. QUARANTINED marks failed validation (bad magic bytes, oversize, scan failure) and is returned as an error, never silently skipped.

extracted_text.description: OCR/document-extracted text when available. Optional; its presence must not be assumed by rules.

pii_redaction_status.description: Face/PII redaction bookkeeping (TECH_SPEC §15.1). MVP default: not_required only when the evidence demonstrably contains no personal data paths.

uuid.description: UUIDv7 (TECH_SPEC §4.1 / docs/03 §4.2): all primary keys are UUIDv7.
